title: Nepal and Bhutan team up for seismic contingency - Nepali Times
description: Nepal and Bhutan team up for seismic contingency  Nepali Times
publisher.title: Nepali Times
full_article:
Residents of the Bhutan capital recently woke up to sirens blaring, roadblocks, all three of the city’s bridges across the Thimphu Chu closed, and ambulances and fire engines rushing about. Those who had not paid attention to notices by the authorities could be forgiven for thinking this was a real disaster.

And that was the whole point of it. The mock exercises included simulated house collapses and building fires to test both information flow, coordination, and decision-making for search and rescue after a high-intensity earthquake.

On hand to design and conduct the simulations were engineers and seismic experts from the National Society for Earthquake Technology (NSET) – Nepal which has wide experience in disaster preparedness and retrofitting projects back home.

The simulation showed that Bhutan was sorely lacking in search and rescue equipment and contingency planning. But at least they now know what to do. Nepali experts say they have to work hard to get successive governments in their own country to listen.

Surya Narayan Shrestha of NSET was impressed with the receptiveness of Bhutan’s officials, right from the prime minister down. He recalls: “After the simulation, Prime Minister Tshering Tobgay told us Bhutan had to learn from Nepal because we are closest to their context, and no other country was in a better position to teach them.”

Such open-minded frankness is rare in the South Asian context where officials and experts often think they know best. The Nepal-Bhutan cooperation was supported by the New Delhi-based Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure (CDRI) of which Nepal is a member, and NSET was selected to support the Thimphu Earthquake Contingency Plan.

NSET helped Bhutan design the strategy in two phases: first to formulate decisions, information flow and coordination mechanisms before a disaster strikes. The second phase consisted of field-based exercises and simulations to analyse how those plans work in practice for search and rescue.

SEISMIC RISK

The 7.4M earthquake in Colombia this week, which followed another deadly temblor in Venezuela last month, was a wakeup call for both Nepal and Bhutan which share similar seismic risk. All four countries can learn from each other to be prepared with building code enforcement, national contingency plans, disaster drills, search and rescue experience.

At one point during the simulation in Thimphu, some sites had modern concrete cutters, while others did not. NSET’s Shrestha remembers the Bhutan search and rescue units wanted to know what they should do. “We asked them what they would do in a real disaster, and gave them a hint: perhaps call for urgent international assistance,” he said.

The authorities had chosen the largest referral hospital in Thimpu and two primary health care centres to create a mass casualty scenario. They factored in a sequence in which emergency medical staff could not reach the hospital either because they had their own family emergencies, or the roads were blocked by landslides, and the hospitals were themselves without power.

The simulation team also assessed the structural integrity of infrastructure, including 11 bridges, one hospital, an electricity terminal, the telecom network, and a food supply warehouse.

The entire simulation took four hours, involving 500 people in various roles, while the Nepali team spent nearly a year planning to execute the two simulation phases. Prime Minister Tobgay, officially the commander of the disaster response team, was also present and King Jigme was kept updated on the exercise.

The outcome of the simulations was analysed, and NSET made a series of recommendations, one of which proposed that Bhutan establish at least one six-person earthquake first responder rescue squad for every ward of 15,000–20,000 people.

Bhutan hasn’t experienced a major earthquake in decades, and sits astride the eastern Himalaya seismic gap. This means tectonic stress has accumulated and could be released at any time. Thimphu has a population of 121,000, and the NSET estimates that 3,000 of the 13,700 houses will face severe damage in the event of a quake of more than 7 magnitude, resulting in 3,000 potential casualties if it hits at night.

Interestingly, NSET’s pre-2015 projection for Kathmandu Valley indicated it was even more vulnerable. The 2015 earthquake was 7.8 magnitude and killed nearly 10,000 people, but seismologists say it did not fully release tectonic tension in central Nepal.

Yet, the irony is that while Nepali experts guide other vulnerable countries, Nepal itself lacks a detailed contingency plan.

“Bhutan learned from us. But what can we learn from them?” asks Shrestha, adding that Nepal needs the same political commitment from the highest levels, rigorous planning and simulation that NSET helped carry out in Thimphu.

To be sure, NSET did help develop a National Disaster Response Framework before the 2015 earthquake that listed the responsibilities of different agencies. But it was only on paper, lacking a strategic implementation plan with sufficient political ownership.

“We have drills but they are more theoretical and do not answer vital questions such as open space, pre-positioned emergency supplies,” says NSET founder Amod Mani Dixit. “What sets Nepal apart from Bhutan is political commitment.” Nepal’s disaster preparedness has improved since 2015, there are more trained people within the security forces, and better equipment. But these are still inadequate to deal with a Himalayan-scale megaquake.

Thule Rai was Nepal’s seniormost search and rescue officer in the Nepal Police and was on NSET’s team in Bhutan. He says of Nepal’s lack of planning pre-2015: “The general thought at the time was why invest in something that is going to happen in the future. But Bhutan was the first to have a simulated contingency plan in the Subcontinent. In Nepal, our plans are on paper and we barely test them.”

That is where the simulation is important because it fills in gaps and sorts out problems in a real-life scenario, using designated officials to resolve them.

Back in 2002, the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) conducted a study on earthquake mitigation in Kathmandu Valley, evaluating structural risks and projecting heavy casualties by using the 1934 8.3M eastern Nepal earthquake as a matrix.

It has been 25 years, and that report has just gathered dust despite being updated in 2018. The National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act 2017 did try to bring risk reduction, preparedness, response as well as search and rescue all under one umbrella, but coordination between line agencies remains the biggest hurdle.

Lack of political will for inter-agency contingency collaboration is possibly Nepal’s biggest problem. Says Surya Narayan Shrestha: “We have awareness and knowledge but no coordination. We have some of the best institutions working in disaster preparedness such as the Armed Police Force, Nepal Police, Red Cross but they are all scattered. That is what we could learn from Bhutan.”

आ एकर पूरा बात एतबे छल। नकली अभ्यास म॑ नकली घरऽ के ढहना आरू भवनऽ म॑ आग लगना शामिल छेलै जेकरा स॑ उच्च तीव्रता वाला भूकंप के बाद खोज आरू बचाव लेली सूचना के प्रवाह, समन्वय आरू निर्णय लेली दूनू के परीक्षण करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै ।

सिमुलेशन के डिजाइन आरू संचालन लेली नेशनल सोसाइटी फॉर भूकंप टेक्नोलॉजी (एनएसईटी) – नेपाल के इंजीनियर आरू भूकंपीय विशेषज्ञ मौजूद छेलै जेकरा घर वापसी म॑ आपदा तत्परता आरू रिट्रोफिटिंग परियोजना के व्यापक अनुभव छै ।

सिमुलेशन स॑ पता चललै कि भूटान म॑ खोज आरू बचाव उपकरण आरू आकस्मिक योजना के बहुत कमी छै । मुदा कमसँ कम आब हुनका सभकेँ बुझल छनि जे की करबाक चाही। नेपाली विशेषज्ञ के कहनाय छनि जे हुनका सभ के अपन देश के लगातार सरकार के सुनय लेल बहुत मेहनत करय पड़त.

एनएसईटी केरऽ सूर्य नारायण श्रेष्ठ भूटान केरऽ अधिकारियऽ के ग्रहणशीलता स॑ प्रभावित छेलै, जे प्रधानमंत्री स॑ ल॑ क॑ नीचें तक छेलै । ओ स्मरण करैत कहैत छथि: “सिमुलेशन के बाद प्रधानमंत्री त्शेरिंग टोबगे हमरा सब के कहलनि जे भूटान के नेपाल स सीखय पड़त, कियाक त हम सब हुनकर संदर्भ के सबस नजदीक छी, आ हुनका सब के सिखाबय के स्थिति में कोनो दोसर देश नै छल।”

दक्षिण एशियाई संदर्भ म॑ ऐसनऽ खुला दिमाग वाला बेबाकपन दुर्लभ छै, जहां अधिकारी आरू विशेषज्ञ अक्सर सोचै छै कि वू सबसें जादा जान॑ छै । नेपाल-भूटान सहयोग के सहयोग नई दिल्ली स्थित कोलिशन फॉर डिजास्टर रेजिलिएंट इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर (सीडीआरआई) केने छल जेकर नेपाल सदस्य अछि, आ एनएसईटी के चयन थिम्फू भूकंप आकस्मिक योजना के समर्थन करय लेल कएल गेल छल.

एनएसईटी न॑ भूटान क॑ ई रणनीति क॑ दू चरण म॑ डिजाइन करै म॑ मदद करलकै: पहलऽ आपदा स॑ पहल॑ फैसला, सूचना प्रवाह आरू समन्वय तंत्र तैयार करना । दोसरऽ चरण म॑ क्षेत्र आधारित अभ्यास आरू सिमुलेशन शामिल छेलै जेकरा स॑ ई विश्लेषण करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै कि खोज आरू बचाव लेली वू योजना व्यवहार म॑ कोना काम करै छै ।

भूकम्पीय जोखिम

पिछला महीना वेनेजुएला में एकटा आओर घातक भूकंप के बाद एहि सप्ताह कोलंबिया में 7.4M के भूकंप आयल नेपाल आ भूटान दुनु देश के लेल जागरण के आह्वान छल जे भूकंपीय जोखिम के समान अछि. चारू देश एक दोसरा सं सीख सकय छै कि बिल्डिंग कोड प्रवर्तन, राष्ट्रीय आकस्मिक योजना, आपदा अभ्यास, खोज आ बचाव कें अनुभव कें साथ तैयार रहनाय.

थिम्फू में सिमुलेशन के दौरान एक समय में किछु जगह पर आधुनिक कंक्रीट कटर छल, जखन कि किछु में नहिं छल. एनएसईटी केरऽ श्रेष्ठ क॑ याद छै कि भूटान केरऽ खोज आरू बचाव इकाई ई जानना चाहै छेलै कि ओकरा की करना चाहियऽ । ओ कहला जे हम हुनका स पूछलहुं जे असली आपदा मे की करब, आ एकटा संकेत देलहुं जे शायद तत्काल अंतरराष्ट्रीय सहायता क आह्वान कैल जाए।

अधिकारी सब थिम्पू के सबस पैघ रेफरल अस्पताल आ दू टा प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य देखभाल केंद्र के चुनने छल जाहि स सामूहिक हताहत के परिदृश्य बनाओल गेल छल। ओ सब एकटा एहन क्रम के कारक बनौलनि जाहि में आपातकालीन चिकित्सा कर्मचारी अस्पताल नहिं पहुँचि सकलाह, कारण जे हुनका लोकनिक अपन पारिवारिक आपातकालीन स्थिति छलनि, वा भूस्खलन सं सड़क जाम भ गेल छलनि, आ अस्पताल स्वयं बिजली सं रहित छल.

सिमुलेशन टीम न॑ बुनियादी ढाँचा केरऽ संरचनात्मक अखंडता के आकलन भी करलकै, जेकरा म॑ ११ पुल, एक अस्पताल, एक बिजली टर्मिनल, दूरसंचार नेटवर्क, आरू एक खाद्य आपूर्ति गोदाम शामिल छै ।

पूरा सिमुलेशन मे चारि घंटा लागल, जाहि मे 500 लोक विभिन्न भूमिका मे शामिल छलाह, जखन कि नेपाली टीम दू सिमुलेशन चरण कए निष्पादित करबाक योजना मे लगभग एक साल बिता देलक। आधिकारिक तौर पर आपदा प्रतिक्रिया टीम केरऽ कमांडर प्रधानमंत्री टोबगे भी मौजूद छेलै आरू राजा जिग्मे क॑ ई अभ्यास के बारे म॑ अपडेट रखलऽ जाय रहलऽ छेलै ।

सिमुलेशन केरऽ परिणाम के विश्लेषण करलऽ गेलै, आरू एनएसईटी न॑ एक श्रृंखला के सिफारिश करलकै, जेकरा म॑ स॑ एगो म॑ प्रस्ताव करलऽ गेलै कि भूटान न॑ १५,०००-२०,००० लोगऽ के हर वार्ड लेली कम स॑ कम एक छह लोगऽ के भूकंप फर्स्ट रिस्पांसर बचाव दस्ता के स्थापना करलऽ जाय ।

भूटान में दशकों सं कोनो पैघ भूकंप नहिं आयल अछि, आ पूर्वी हिमालयक भूकंपीय अंतराल पर सवार भ’ बैसल अछि. एकरऽ मतलब छै कि विवर्तनिक तनाव जमा होय गेलऽ छै आरू ई कोनो भी समय छोड़लऽ जाब॑ सकै छै । थिम्फू केरऽ आबादी १,२१,००० छै, आरू एनएसईटी केरऽ अनुमान छै कि ७ तीव्रता स॑ अधिक के भूकंप के स्थिति म॑ १३,७०० घरऽ म॑ स॑ ३,००० घरऽ क॑ भारी नुकसान के सामना करना पड़तै, जेकरऽ परिणामस्वरूप अगर रात म॑ आबै छै त॑ ३,००० लोगऽ के संभावित जानमाल के नुकसान होय ​​सकै छै ।

मजेदार बात ई छै कि एनएसईटी केरऽ २०१५ स॑ पहल॑ काठमांडू घाटी केरऽ प्रोजेक्शन म॑ ई आरू भी कमजोर होय के संकेत मिललै । 2015 के भूकंप 7.8 तीव्रता के छल आ लगभग 10,000 लोक के मौत भ गेल छल, मुदा भूकंप विज्ञानी के कहनाय छनि जे एहि सं मध्य नेपाल मे विवर्तनिक तनाव पूर्ण रूप सं नहि छोड़ल गेल छल.

तइयो विडंबना ई अछि जे नेपाली विशेषज्ञ अन्य कमजोर देशक मार्गदर्शन करैत छथि, नेपाल मे स्वयं विस्तृत आकस्मिक योजनाक अभाव अछि ।

ओ कहला जे भूटान हमरा सब स सीखल। मुदा हम सभ हुनका सभसँ की सीख सकैत छी?” श्रेष्ठ पूछै छै, आरू कहलकै कि नेपाल क॑ उच्चतम स्तर स॑ वू राजनीतिक प्रतिबद्धता, कठोर योजना आरू सिमुलेशन के जरूरत छै जे एनएसईटी न॑ थिम्फू म॑ करै म॑ मदद करलकै ।

ई बात निश्चित छै कि एनएसईटी न॑ २०१५ केरऽ भूकंप स॑ पहल॑ एगो राष्ट्रीय आपदा प्रतिक्रिया ढाँचा तैयार करै म॑ जरूर मदद करलकै जेकरा म॑ अलग-अलग एजेंसियऽ के जिम्मेदारी के सूची देलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । लेकिन ई खाली कागज पर छेलै, जेकरा म॑ पर्याप्त राजनीतिक स्वामित्व वाला रणनीतिक कार्यान्वयन योजना के कमी छेलै ।

एनएसईटी केरऽ संस्थापक आमोद मणि दीक्षित न॑ कहलकै कि हमरा पास ड्रिल छै लेकिन ई अधिक सैद्धांतिक छै आरू खुला जगह, पूर्व-स्थापित आपातकालीन आपूर्ति जैसनऽ महत्वपूर्ण सवालऽ के जवाब नै दै छै । “नेपाल क॑ भूटान स॑ अलग करै वाला बात छै राजनीतिक प्रतिबद्धता ।” नेपाल केरऽ आपदा तत्परता म॑ २०१५ स॑ सुधार होय गेलऽ छै, सुरक्षा बल के भीतर प्रशिक्षित लोगऽ के संख्या अधिक छै, आरू उपकरण भी बेहतर छै । लेकिन ई सब अखनी भी हिमालय पैमाना पर आबै वाला मेगाक्वेक स॑ निपटै लेली अपर्याप्त छै ।

थुले राय नेपाल पुलिस मे नेपाल के सबस वरिष्ठ खोज आ बचाव अधिकारी छलाह आ भूटान मे एनएसईटी के टीम मे छलाह. नेपाल केरऽ २०१५ स॑ पहल॑ के योजना के कमी के बारे म॑ हुनी कहै छै कि वू समय केरऽ सामान्य विचार छेलै कि भविष्य म॑ जे कुछ होतै ओकरा म॑ निवेश कियैक करलऽ जाय । लेकिन भूटान सबसें पहलऽ उपमहाद्वीप म॑ नकली आकस्मिक योजना बनैलकै । नेपाल मे हमर सबहक योजना कागज पर अछि आ हम सब मुश्किल स ओकर परीक्षण करैत छी।”

यहीं पर सिमुलेशन महत्वपूर्ण छै, कैन्हेंकि ई वास्तविक जीवन केरऽ परिदृश्य म॑ रिक्त स्थान क॑ भर॑ छै आरू समस्या क॑ हल करै छै, जेकरा स॑ ओकरा हल करै लेली नामित अधिकारियऽ के इस्तेमाल करलऽ जाय छै ।

2002 म॑ ही जापान अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सहयोग एजेंसी (JICA) न॑ काठमांडू घाटी म॑ भूकंप शमन के बारे म॑ एगो अध्ययन करलकै, जेकरा म॑ संरचनात्मक जोखिम के मूल्यांकन करलऽ गेलै आरू १९३४ केरऽ ८.३ मीटर पूर्वी नेपाल भूकंप क॑ मैट्रिक्स के रूप म॑ इस्तेमाल करी क॑ भारी जानमाल के नुकसान के अनुमान लगाय देलऽ गेलै ।

25 साल भ गेल छै, आ ओ रिपोर्ट 2018 मे अपडेट करला कें बावजूद एखनहि धूल जमा भेल छै.राष्ट्रीय आपदा जोखिम कम करय आ प्रबंधन अधिनियम 2017 मे जोखिम मे कमी, तैयारी, प्रतिक्रिया कें साथ-साथ खोज आ बचाव सब कें एकटा छत्रछाया मे लावय कें कोशिश जरूर कैल गेलय, मुदा लाइन एजेंसी कें बीच समन्वय सब सं पैघ बाधा बनल छै.

अंतर-एजेंसी आकस्मिक सहयोग के लेल राजनीतिक इच्छाशक्ति के अभाव संभवतः नेपाल के सबस पैघ समस्या अछि. सूर्य नारायण श्रेष्ठ कहैत छथि जे हमरा सब लग जागरूकता आ ज्ञान अछि मुदा समन्वय नहि अछि। हमरा सब लग आपदा तत्परता मे काज करय वाला किछ बेहतरीन संस्थान अछि जेना सशस्त्र पुलिस बल, नेपाल पुलिस, रेड क्रॉस मुदा ओ सब छिड़ियाएल अछि. भूटान स हम सब इएह सीख सकैत छलहुं।”

title: Biratnagar Jute Mills: A historic legacy awaiting revival - The Rising Nepal

full_article:
By Nabaraj Kattel, Biratnagar, Aug. 15: Biratnagar Jute Mills, which gave rise to the Sunsari-Morang industrial corridor, was a Rana-era factory that helped usher in an industrial wave in Nepal. Established in 1936 (1993 BS), it is not only an important part of the country's industrial history but also became a centre from which democratic political awareness spread.

The jute mill is closely linked with key events in Nepal's democratic movement. The 1946 (2003 BS) movement for democracy and the establishment of Radio Prajatantra in 1949 (2006 BS) are both recorded in the country's history alongside the mill. Once providing employment to around 8,000 workers, the factory is now remembered more as a source of historical pride than as a functioning industrial enterprise.

Located in Biratnagar-15, Rani, the mill is now overgrown with weeds and vegetation, while its buildings and other structures continue to deteriorate. Some structures are collapsing, while others have already fallen into disrepair.

Nanda Lal Devkota, chairman of Biratnagar Jute Mills, said the government has now formed a study task force, which he believes could help find a solution for the mill. He argues that there is still a possibility of operating the factory.

However, he said the mill's condition from its past to the present must be assessed comprehensively, along with the investment required for its future operation.

Former chairman Rajendra Karki said that although efforts to preserve the mill's history are positive in principle, its operational condition has become extremely weak. However, he said, “If the government is willing, the mill's ownership and property can still be properly protected, even if restarting production is no longer feasible.” Karki resigned on May 2, 2026 (Baisakh 19), after which the board of directors appointed Devkota as chairman.

Although the mill has been unable to operate, successive boards of directors have continued to be formed. The jute mill has been in decline since 2046 BS and has been completely closed since 2013 (2070 BS). Several boards have been appointed since its closure, but its financial condition remains extremely weak.

A 2015 (2072 BS) assessment showed that the mill had total liabilities of Rs. 3.2 billion. During the tenure of then-chairman Nilhari Kafle, efforts were made to move the company forward in accordance with legal procedures, prompting a detailed assessment of its overall financial position.

At the time, records at the Office of the Company Registrar showed the mill as a public limited company, with the Government of Nepal holding a 46 per cent stake. According to that assessment, the mill still owed Rs. 1.5429 billion on a loan of Rs. 17.5 million taken from Nepal Bank in 1982 (2039 BS). It also owed Rs. 10.7 million on a Rs. 1 million loan from NIDC, while a Rs. 45 million loan taken from Udayapur Cement Industries Limited in 1994 (2051 BS) had risen to Rs. 85 million including interest. In addition, Rs. 53,000 worth of medicines purchased on credit from Nepal Drugs Limited in 1996 (2053 BS) remained unpaid.

Former chairman Karki said that the mill's net tax arrears dating back to 1979 (2036 BS), including penalties, fines and interest, had reached Rs. 145 million. In 2015 (2072 BS), the government at the time facilitated a settlement of the tax liabilities through the Tax Settlement Commission. Current chairman Devkota said the mill's latest financial position is still being verified. He said the government-formed task force would also examine all aspects of the mill.

Despite having assets, the mill has accumulated greater liabilities, and its proposed revival has repeatedly become a subject of political manoeuvring. According to the mill's financial records, the government had provided Rs. 1.0963 billion in concessional loans up to the 2009/2010 financial year. Including interest, the liability had risen to Rs. 1.7213 billion by 2015.

Similarly, a Rs. 10.44 million loan provided by the Asian Development Bank for modernisation had increased to Rs. 57.04 million a decade ago. A loan of Rs. 91.65 million raised through debentures had grown to Rs. 431.17 million, according to the 2015 report.

Whatever the mill's operational condition, records show that it owns around 69 bighas of land. Experts said government intervention is necessary to protect this valuable property.

Chairman Devkota said that five daily-wage security guards and two administrative employees are currently working at the mill. He said the authorities would decide what course to take only after completing a comprehensive assessment of its condition.

The factory had been running at a loss since 1993. In an attempt to revive it, the government leased the mill to Winsome International of Kolkata, India, for 25 years in 2012. However, the company terminated the agreement and withdrew after just one year and three months.

Before that, Arihant Multi Fibres had taken the mill on a five-year lease in 2002. Arihant also withdrew from the agreement in 2005.

विराटनगर जूट मिल्सके अध्यक्ष नन्दलाल देवकोटा अखन सरकार स्टडी टास्क फोर्स गठन केने अछि, जकरासँ मिलके समाधान ताकबामे सहयोग भेटि सकैत अछि से हुनकर मानब रहल बतौलनि । हुनकर तर्क अछि जे एखनो एहि कारखाना कए संचालित करबाक संभावना अछि।

हालांकि ओ कहला जे मिल क अतीत स वर्तमान तक क स्थिति क व्यापक आकलन करबाक चाही, संगहि एकर भविष्य क संचालन लेल जरूरी निवेश सेहो होएत।

पूर्व अध्यक्ष राजेन्द्र कार्की कहलनि जे, मिल के इतिहास के संरक्षण के प्रयास भले सिद्धांत रूप मे सकारात्मक अछि, मुदा एकर परिचालन के स्थिति अत्यंत कमजोर भ गेल अछि। ओना ओ कहला जे सरकार इच्छुक अछि त मिल क मालिकाना हक आ संपत्ति कए एखनो ठीक स सुरक्षित राखल जा सकैत अछि, भले उत्पादन कए फेर स शुरू करब आब संभव नहि भ जाए।” कार्की २ मई २०२६ (बैसाख १९) के इस्तीफा द देलक, जकर बाद संचालक मंडल देवकोटा के अध्यक्ष नियुक्त केलक।

हालांकि मिल संचालित नहि भ सकल अछि, मुदा लगातार निदेशक मंडल क गठन जारी अछि। जूट मिल 2046 बीएस स घटैत अछि आ 2013 (2070 बीएस) स पूर्ण रूप स बंद अछि। एकरऽ बंद होय के बाद स॑ कईएक बोर्ड के नियुक्ति होय चुकलऽ छै, लेकिन एकरऽ आर्थिक हालत अत्यंत कमजोर बनलऽ छै ।

पूर्व अध्यक्ष कार्की कहलनि जे, मिल के 1979 (2036 बीएस) के शुद्ध कर बकाया, जाहि मे जुर्माना, जुर्माना आ ब्याज शामिल अछि, 100 रुपया तक पहुंच गेल अछि। 14.5 करोड़ रुपया। 2015 (2072 बीएस) मे ओहि समय सरकार कर निपटान आयोग क माध्यम स कर देयता क निपटारा क सुविधा देलक। वर्तमान अध्यक्ष देवकोटा कहला जे मिल क नवीनतम वित्तीय स्थिति क सत्यापन एखनो भ रहल अछि। ओ कहला जे सरकार द्वारा गठित टास्क फोर्स सेहो मिल क सब पहलू क जांच करत।

संपत्ति के बावजूद मिल में बेसी देयता जमा भ गेल अछि, आ एकर प्रस्तावित पुनरुद्धार बेर-बेर राजनीतिक पैंतराबाजी के विषय बनि गेल अछि. मिल के वित्तीय रिकॉर्ड के अनुसार सरकार 100 रुपया के प्रावधान केने छल। 2009/2010 वित्तीय वर्ष तक रियायती ऋण मे 1.0963 अरब टका देल गेल अछि। ब्याज सहित देयता बढ़ि कए 100 टका भ गेल छल। 2015 तक 1.7213 अरब।

अध्यक्ष देवकोटा कहलनि जे, एखन मिल मे पांच दैनिक मजदूरी वाला सुरक्षा गार्ड आ दूटा प्रशासनिक कर्मचारी काज क रहल छथि। ओ कहला जे अधिकारी एकर स्थिति क व्यापक आकलन पूरा केलाक बाद मात्र इ तय करत जे कोन कोर्स करब।

1993 स इ फैक्ट्री घाटा मे चलि रहल छल, एकरा फेर स जीवित करबाक कोशिश मे सरकार 2012 मे एहि मिल कए भारत क कोलकाता क विनसम इंटरनेशनल कए 25 साल लेल पट्टा पर द देलक। मुदा कंपनी एहि समझौता कए समाप्त करि मात्र एक साल तीन मास क बाद वापस ल लेलक।

title: Wildfire forces hundreds to flee in western Germany - The Rising Nepal
description: Wildfire forces hundreds to flee in western Germany  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
Hürtgenwald (Germany), Aug. 15: Around 1,800 people had to flee their homes in western Germany overnight after a wildfire spread nearby, officials said Friday, with helicopters and army equipment deployed to help battle the flames.

A district of the town of Huertgenwald near the Belgian and Dutch borders was evacuated after the fire expanded from 25 hectares (around 60 acres) to 300 hectares by Friday morning. German media reported explosions overnight as the fire set off wartime munitions which hampered the fight against the blaze in the hilly Eifel region of North Rhine-Westphalia state.

Residents were urged to "take only the most important personal items" with them as the fire drew nearer, with temporary shelters set up in a nearby school and a sports centre, officials said. Around 300 emergency services personnel were deployed in an operation backed by helicopters and army tracked vehicles as emergency crew cut firebreaks through the woods. "It's a really alarming feeling," local resident Sabine Baldus told broadcaster NTV.

She said she saw columns of black smoke on Thursday evening and left during the night. Now staying with an uncle nearby, she said the "smell is bad here too and there is ash falling from the sky". District administrator Ralf Nolten told journalists later Friday that the fire had stabilised and further evacuations were not necessary "for now".

However, he warned that "we are not done yet" and that the fire could worsen again if the wind picks up. Emergency services were also in action overnight fighting another wildfire further east near the Moehnesee lake, also in North Rhine-Westphalia.

Around 100 emergency service workers managed to contain that fire, despite dangerous conditions and difficult topography. The EU's global warming monitor has said that Western Europe experienced its hottest June-July on record as climate change fuels an historic summer of heat, drought and wildfires.

The heatwave in late June saw Germany break its temperature record for three days in a row, hitting 41.7C. Temperatures of up to 39C are expected in western Germany on Friday, with the current heatwave set to last into the weekend.

title: Tourists cool off with Colosseum nights - The Rising Nepal
description: Tourists cool off with Colosseum nights  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
Rome, Aug. 15: The Colosseum has extended opening hours at night this summer to allow more visitors to see the famous Roman amphitheatre in cooler temperatures after sunset. The night tours, which run until 11:00 pm, are sold out and tourists on one visit this week spoke of a "magical" and "romantic" atmosphere in the illuminated monument.

"After sunset is a lot more comfortable," Victor Li, 52, told AFP as he toured the arena and the underground passages where animals and gladiators were once held. "It's a good idea because it's really hot in the morning and during the day," said Svetlana Spielberg, visiting from the United States, adding that it was "really beautiful" and "more romantic" at night.

The Colosseum was already offering tours two nights a week but doubled that number to four this summer. Officials said some tourists were staying away because of the intensifying heatwaves in the Italian capital. "The idea of doubling the night tours and doing them also on Fridays and Saturdays was mainly to give access to visitors that prefer cooler hours," said Simone Quilici, director of the Colosseum complex.

The extended opening had been made possible thanks to a grant from the Italian culture ministry and the initiative could be extended into September, he added. The tours are all guided and numbers have been kept low -- at just 275 people a night. The monument gets up to 20,000 visitors a day at peak times.

The Colosseum, the largest amphitheatre in the world, was built in the first century and was used to host events like animal hunts and gladiatorial games. It could hold around 50,000 spectators. Marco Pravini, who was visiting from Cremona, said he had also visited the amphitheatre during the day but "at night the light, the atmosphere is much more magical".

title: US ends TPS for Nepali citizens, putting beneficiaries at risk - Khabarhub
description: US ends TPS for Nepali citizens, putting beneficiaries at risk  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
KATHMANDU: The US government has decided to terminate Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for citizens of Nepal and several other countries.

According to the US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), Nepal’s TPS designation had expired a year ago, but a decision on whether to extend or terminate the protection had not been made.

The US government has now concluded that there is no longer a legal basis to maintain TPS for Nepali citizens and has decided to end the programme.

Under TPS, eligible citizens of designated countries are allowed to remain and work in the United States for a specified period and are temporarily protected from deportation.

With the termination of TPS, Nepali citizens who do not have another valid immigration status may be required to leave the United States. The decision is therefore expected to create uncertainty and risks for Nepali nationals currently residing in the US under TPS.

The US government has also announced the termination of TPS for citizens of Haiti, Syria, Yemen, Afghanistan, Cameroon, Honduras, Nicaragua, Venezuela, South Sudan, Myanmar (Burma), Somalia and Ethiopia, among other countries.

TPS is a form of temporary legal protection granted by the US to citizens who cannot safely return to their home countries due to armed conflict, natural disasters or other extraordinary circumstances.

title: Delhi police bust Indo-Nepal charas syndicate, seize 106 kg contraband worth Rs 109 crore - The New Indian Express
description: Delhi police bust Indo-Nepal charas syndicate, seize 106 kg contraband worth Rs 109 crore  The New Indian Express
publisher.title: The New Indian Express
full_article:
NEW DELHI: Police have busted an alleged Indo-Nepal narcotics syndicate that used auto-rickshaws and bike taxis to ferry charas to its customers in Delhi-NCR, with the arrest of four Nepalese nationals and seizure of over 106 kg of the contraband worth over Rs 109 crore, an officer said Friday.

Among the four arrested is the key accused, who is based in Delhi and was involved in the bulk storage and distribution of the narcotics. The network involved cross-border transportation, procurement, storage and distribution in Delhi-NCR.

The arrest follows an intelligence input received on June 29 about the involvement of Nepalese nationals in the supply of charas in Delhi-NCR. A police team traced their movements and conducted a raid at a house in Kotla Mubarakpur, nabbing three of the accused—Bharat Thapa, Govind Budha and Jyoti Pun Magar. A total 8.598 kg of charas was recovered from their possession, a senior police officer said.

Concerted efforts to unearth the whole chain revealed the names of suppliers Binmaya and Roshni.

Sustained interrogation, technical surveillance, financial analysis and local intelligence led police to Roshni Magar, who was allegedly operating a major storage and distribution point in Wazirabad, an officer said.

title: US ends TPS protection for Nepali immigrants - The Kathmandu Post
description: US ends TPS protection for Nepali immigrants  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
The United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS) has officially announced the termination of Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Nepal, ordering affected individuals to leave the country or face formal deportation proceedings.

In an official public notification, the DHS confirmed that TPS terminations are now active across a broad list of designated nations. The table published by DHS leadership lists 13 countries—including Nepal, Haiti, Syria, Yemen, Afghanistan, Cameroon, Honduras, Nicaragua, Venezuela, South Sudan, Burma, Somalia, and Ethiopia—signalling a comprehensive tightening of humanitarian immigration status.

The announcement warned affected individuals with terminated status to make immediate arrangements to depart the US.

The decision brings an abrupt end to humanitarian relief that has shielded thousands of Nepali immigrants for over a decade. Nepal was initially designated for TPS on 24 June 2015 following the catastrophic 7.8-magnitude earthquake, which claimed nearly 9,000 lives, destroyed critical infrastructure, and severely disrupted economic stability across the nation. The special status permitted eligible Nepali citizens living in the US to reside and work legally without fear of removal.

According to official estimates from the Department of Homeland Security, approximately 12,700 Nepali nationals were holding TPS status before the phase-out process. While around 5,500 of those beneficiaries have successfully adjusted their status to permanent residency over the past decade, thousands of others remain reliant solely on TPS for legal residence and Employment Authorisation Documents (EADs).

अमेरिका के होमलैंड सिक्योरिटी विभाग नेपाल के लेल अस्थायी संरक्षित दर्जा (टीपीएस) समाप्त करय के आधिकारिक घोषणा केलक अछि, जाहि मे प्रभावित व्यक्ति के देश छोड़य के आदेश देल गेल अछि या औपचारिक रूप सं निर्वासन के प्रक्रिया के सामना करय पड़त.

एकटा आधिकारिक सार्वजनिक अधिसूचना मे डीएचएस इ पुष्टि केलक छै कि टीपीएस समाप्ति आब नामित राष्ट्रक कें एकटा व्यापक सूची मे सक्रिय छै. डीएचएस नेतृत्व द्वारा प्रकाशित तालिका म॑ १३ देशऽ के सूची देलऽ गेलऽ छै-जेकरा म॑ नेपाल, हैती, सीरिया, यमन, अफगानिस्तान, कैमरून, होन्डुरस, निकारागुआ, वेनेजुएला, दक्षिण सूडान, बर्मा, सोमालिया, आरू इथियोपिया शामिल छै-जे मानवीय आप्रवासन केरऽ स्थिति म॑ व्यापक कसाव के संकेत दै छै ।

घोषणा म॑ समाप्त होय के दर्जा वाला प्रभावित व्यक्ति सिनी क॑ चेतावनी देलऽ गेलऽ छै कि हुनी तुरंत अमेरिका स॑ रवाना होय के व्यवस्था करै ।

ई फैसला स॑ मानवीय राहत केरऽ अचानक अंत होय गेलऽ छै जेकरा स॑ एक दशक स॑ भी अधिक समय स॑ हजारों नेपाली आप्रवासी क॑ ढाल मिललऽ छै । नेपाल क॑ शुरू म॑ २४ जून २०१५ क॑ ७.८ तीव्रता के भयावह भूकंप के बाद टीपीएस लेली नामित करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै, जेकरा म॑ लगभग ९,००० लोगऽ के जान गेलै, महत्वपूर्ण बुनियादी ढाँचा नष्ट होय गेलै, आरू पूरा राष्ट्र म॑ आर्थिक स्थिरता म॑ गंभीर बाधा पहुँचलै । विशेष दर्जा के कारण अमेरिका में रहय वाला पात्र नेपाली नागरिक के बिना हटाबय के डर के कानूनी तौर पर रहय आ काज करय के अनुमति छल.

गृह सुरक्षा विभाग केरऽ आधिकारिक अनुमान के अनुसार चरणबद्ध तरीका स॑ समाप्त करै के प्रक्रिया स॑ पहल॑ लगभग १२,७०० नेपाली नागरिक टीपीएस के दर्जा धारण करी रहलऽ छेलै । जखन कि ओय लाभार्थियक मे सं लगभग 5,500 पिछला एक दशक मे अपन स्थिति कें स्थायी निवास कें लेल सफलतापूर्वक समायोजित कयर चुकल छै, हजारक अन्य लोग कानूनी निवास आ रोजगार प्राधिकरण दस्तावेजक (ईएडी) कें लेल केवल टीपीएस पर निर्भर छै.

title: India Celebrates 80th Independence Day with Nepali Support - Ratopati
description: India Celebrates 80th Independence Day with Nepali Support  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. India is celebrating its 80th Independence Day. Indian missions in India and around the world are celebrating this day with various programs.

Neighboring country Nepal also has its own impact. The Indian Embassy in Nepal is celebrating Independence Day with various programs, and various organizations in Nepal are also organizing programs on this occasion.

The main reason for celebrating Independence Day in Nepal is the direct participation of Nepal in the Indian independence struggle. In 2004 BS, Nepal's contemporary revolutionary youth directly participated in India's fight against the British. Not only that, the common people of Nepal living in the border areas also supported India's struggle, says Khushilal Mandal, an old leader from Saptari.

There was no village in Terai-Madhesh where Indian leaders did not stay at that time. Leaders fleeing from India were hiding in one house or another in every village. The Nepali people provided them with shelter and necessary support. The relationship established at that time has become even deeper now.

Leaders like Nepali Congress leader BP Koirala, Communist Party leader Manmohan Adhikari, leader Matrika Prasad Koirala, Dr. Dilliraman Regmi, Tulsi Meher Shrestha, Jayamangal Prasad Singh, Rameshwar Singh, among others, supported the fight against the British. Jayamangal Prasad Singh is the father of Ramraja Prasad Singh, and Rameshwar Singh is also his relative.

It is mentioned in various documents in Nepal that Nepal's first democratically elected Prime Minister BP Koirala and former Prime Minister Manmohan Adhikari were fighters in the Indian freedom struggle. They were arrested by the British government on charges of supporting the movement and kept in various jails in Hazaribagh and Patna along with leaders of the Indian National Congress.

Leaders like Matrika Prasad Koirala, Dr. Dilliraman Regmi, Tulsi Meher Shrestha, among others, went to various places in India and participated in the movement started by Mahatma Gandhi. At that time, when the Rana regime was dominant in Nepal, leaders were forced to live in exile in India. During that time, the movement against the British started in India, and they plunged into it.

Not only that, Nepali students studying in Banaras, Kolkata, Patna, and Lucknow in India also participated in the freedom struggle. During the movement, they distributed pamphlets, propagated, and organized rallies and gatherings. It is a history that litterateurs like Laxmi Prasad Devkota, Dharanidhar Koirala, Motiram Bhatta supported the Indian freedom struggle through their writings.

Hanumannagar Incident

In 1942, when the movement against the British was going on in India, many leaders were arrested and jailed. Among them were Indian leaders Jayaprakash (JP) Narayan and Rammanohar Lohia. They were in Hazaribagh jail. As the movement intensified in India, they escaped from jail. However, even after escaping from jail, it was difficult for them to hide in India.

According to an article written by Manjeev Singh Puri, former Indian Ambassador to Nepal, in the Hindustan Times, the Ranas at that time were in favor of the British rule. Because of this, it was difficult for them to hide even in Nepal. Nevertheless, they reached Hanumannagar via the Saptari border by various means. They were given shelter by the local Rameshwar Singh. They were operating the activities of the ongoing movement in India while staying in Nepal.

According to leader Mandal, JP Narayan even held a conference of his party in Nepal. Indian leaders from places like Bihar and UP in India attended that conference. Many leaders and common people from Nepal also participated in it. This spread JP's ideology in Nepal as well. Documents of the freedom struggle happening in India were prepared and spread in Nepal and India.

As the movement against the British gained momentum in Nepal, leaders like JP Narayan and Rammanohar Lohia were arrested and put in Hanumannagar jail in 1943. Later, with the help of Rameshwar Singh, Indian leaders Surjnarayan Singh and others succeeded in breaking the Hanumannagar jail and helping them escape from there. Leader Mandal says that the local people also supported the jailbreak.

Support in the Movement Against the Ranas

Former Ambassador Puri has mentioned that the Hanumannagar incident also helped in removing the Rana regime in Nepal. The fire ignited by the Hanumannagar movement also engulfed the Ranas. Leader Mandal said that many leaders in Nepal were arrested at that time on charges of helping Indian leaders escape from jail. People from some places in Saptari were arrested and brought to Kathmandu jail.

Rameshwar Singh was considered the main accused by the then government for providing shelter to JP Narayan, Rammanohar Lohia, and others in Nepal. Later, they were released at the request of the Indian government.

Gorkhali Durga Malla, who was in the British Army, rebelled and supported Indian leader Subhas Chandra Bose when the fight against the British began in India. He was the first Gorkhali soldier to sacrifice his life fighting for India's independence. He was sentenced to death by the British government. A statue has been erected in his memory in the Parliament House complex in India.

On the occasion of Independence Day, not only in Nepal but also in India, the contribution of Nepalis is remembered. India had full support in the movement against the Ranas in 2007 BS.

Leader Mandal says, 'It was because of supporting the movement against the British that the then government of India supported the leaders of Nepal in the movement against the Ranas. The biggest support in this came from Jayaprakash Narayan and Rammanohar Lohia. Both of them took Subarnashamsher Rana to meet the then Prime Minister of India, Jawaharlal Nehru.'

However, Prime Minister Nehru replied that he would not support an armed struggle. After receiving the reply, 'If you are going to have a peaceful movement, there will be support, otherwise there will be no support for an armed movement,' they met with the then Home Minister Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. When Home Minister Patel asked what help he wanted from him, Jayaprakash Narayan and Lohia said to tell the machinery under the Home Ministry to remain silent for a few days in the context of Nepal, and they would do the rest of the work themselves.

After that, Jayaprakash Narayan and others brought weapons from Burma and gave them to BP Koirala and others. Then, leader Mandal recalls, the armed movement against the Ranas began in Nepal. Due to the success of the revolutions in both countries at approximately the same time with mutual support, Nepal-India relations are viewed specially. In Nepal, there was a cruel Rana regime, just as there was British rule in India.

Many leaders were jailed at that time. Some were forced to live in exile in India, while the Ranas even confiscated the property of some leaders. Political analysts say that just as much effort was put into removing the British from India, the same effort was required to remove the Rana regime in Nepal, and India's support was immense.

The Nepali Congress was established in January 1947 at India's Khalsa College. Old journalist Sukeshwar Pathak says that in the manifesto of that time, leaders pledged to fight equally for the independence of India and Nepal.

The fact that the Ranas of Nepal helped the British to suppress the movement against the British in India also led to the belief that this regime must end, and support was received from India. At that time, due to the lack of good schools and colleges in Nepal, most Nepali students used to go to various colleges in India.

They participated in every movement, rally, and conference held there. Following their example, those students (who later became leaders) started movements in Nepal.
translated:
काठमांडू। भारत अपन 80म स्वतंत्रता दिवस मना रहल अछि। भारत आरू दुनिया भर के भारतीय मिशन सब विभिन्न कार्यक्रम के साथ ई दिन मनाबै छै ।

पड़ोसी देश नेपाल सेहो अपन प्रभाव पड़ैत अछि । नेपाल मे भारतीय दूतावास विभिन्न कार्यक्रम स स्वतंत्रता दिवस मना रहल अछि, आ नेपाल के विभिन्न संस्था सब सेहो एहि अवसर पर कार्यक्रम के आयोजन क रहल अछि ।

नेपाल मे स्वतंत्रता दिवस मनाबय के मुख्य कारण भारतीय स्वतंत्रता संग्राम मे नेपाल के प्रत्यक्ष भागीदारी अछि । 2004 बी.एस.मे नेपालक समकालीन क्रान्तिकारी युवा लोकनि अंग्रेजक विरुद्ध भारतक लड़ाई मे सोझे भाग लेलनि । एतबे नहि, सीमा क्षेत्र मे रहनिहार नेपालक आम जनता सेहो भारतक संघर्षक समर्थन केलक, सप्तरीक पुरान नेता खुशीलाल मंडल कहैत छथि ।

तराई-मधेश मे एहन कोनो गाम नहि छल जतय ओहि समय भारतीय नेता नहि रहैत छलाह | भारत स भागैत नेता सब गाम मे कोनो ने कोनो घर मे नुकायल छलाह। नेपाली जनता हुनका सब के आश्रय आ आवश्यक सहयोग प्रदान केलक । ओहि समय मे स्थापित संबंध आब आओर गहींर भ गेल अछि।

नेपाली कांग्रेस नेता बीपी कोइराला, कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी के नेता मनमोहन अधिकारी, नेता मातृका प्रसाद कोइराला, डॉ. डिल्लीरमण रेग्मी, तुलसी मेहेर श्रेष्ठ, जयमंगल प्रसाद सिंह, रामेश्वर सिंह आदि नेता सब अंग्रेज के खिलाफ लड़ाई के समर्थन केलनि। जयमंगल प्रसाद सिंह रामराज प्रसाद सिंह के पिता छैथ, आ रामेश्वर सिंह सेहो हुनकर रिश्तेदार छैथ |

नेपालक विभिन्न दस्तावेज मे उल्लेख अछि जे नेपालक पहिल लोकतांत्रिक तरीका सँ निर्वाचित प्रधानमन्त्री बी.पी.कोइराला आ पूर्व प्रधानमन्त्री मनमोहन अधिकारी भारतीय स्वतंत्रता संग्राम मे सेनानी छलाह । आन्दोलन के समर्थन के आरोप में ब्रिटिश सरकार द्वारा गिरफ्तार क भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के नेता सब के संग हजारीबाग आ पटना के विभिन्न जेल में राखल गेल छल।

मातृका प्रसाद कोइराला, डॉ. डिल्लीरमण रेग्मी, तुलसी मेहेर श्रेष्ठ आदि नेता लोकनि भारतक विभिन्न स्थान पर जा कए महात्मा गांधी द्वारा शुरू कयल गेल आन्दोलन मे भाग लेलनि । ओहि समय जखन नेपाल मे राणा शासनक प्रबल छल तखन नेता लोकनि भारत मे निर्वासन मे रहय लेल बाध्य छलाह | ओहि समय मे भारत मे अंग्रेजक विरुद्ध आन्दोलन शुरू भेल, आ ओ लोकनि ओहि मे डूबि गेलाह |

एतबे नहि भारतक बनारस, कोलकाता, पटना, आ लखनऊ मे पढ़निहार नेपाली छात्र लोकनि सेहो स्वतंत्रता संग्राम मे भाग लेलनि । आन्दोलन के दौरान पम्पलेट बांटैत छल, प्रचार करैत छल, आ सभा आ सभा के आयोजन करैत छल | ई इतिहास छै कि लक्ष्मी प्रसाद देवकोटा, धरनीधर कोइराला, मोतीराम भट्ट जैसनऽ साहित्यकार न॑ अपनऽ लेखन के माध्यम स॑ भारतीय स्वतंत्रता संग्राम के समर्थन करलकै ।

हनुमाननगर घटना

1942 मे जखन भारत मे अंग्रेज के खिलाफ आन्दोलन चलि रहल छल तखन कतेको नेता के गिरफ्तार क जेल मे बंद क देल गेल। एहि मे भारतीय नेता जयप्रकाश (जेपी) नारायण आओर राममनोहर लोहिया शामिल छलाह. ओ सभ हजारीबाग जेल मे छल। भारत मे जेना-जेना आन्दोलन तेज होइत गेल, ओ सब जेल सँ भागि गेल। मुदा, जेलसँ भागलाक बादो भारतमे नुकाएब कठिन छल ।

हिन्दुस्तान टाइम्स मे नेपाल मे भारतीय पूर्व राजदूत मंजीव सिंह पुरी द्वारा लिखल गेल लेख के अनुसार ओहि समय के राणा अंग्रेज शासन के पक्ष मे छल । एहि कारणे नेपाल मे सेहो हुनका लोकनिक लेल नुकाब कठिन छल । तइयो विभिन्न साधन सँ सप्तरी सीमा होइत हनुमाननगर पहुँचलाह | स्थानीय रामेश्वर सिंह हुनका सब के आश्रय देलखिन। नेपाल मे रहैत भारत मे चलि रहल आन्दोलन के गतिविधि संचालित क रहल छलाह ।

नेता मंडल के अनुसार जेपी नारायण नेपाल में अपन पार्टी के सम्मेलन तक के आयोजन कायल गेल छल। ओहि सम्मेलन मे भारत मे बिहार आओर यूपी जकां जगह सं भारतीय नेता सभ भाग लेलखिन्ह. एहि मे नेपाल सँ बहुत रास नेता आ आम लोक सेहो भाग लेलनि । एहि स नेपाल मे सेहो जेपी क विचारधारा पसरल। भारत मे भ रहल स्वतंत्रता संग्राम के दस्तावेज तैयार क नेपाल आ भारत मे पसरल गेल ।

नेपाल में अंग्रेज के खिलाफ आन्दोलन के गति बढ़ला पर जेपी नारायण आ राममनोहर लोहिया सन नेता के गिरफ्तार क 1943 में हनुमाननगर जेल में राखल गेल।बाद में रामेश्वर सिंह के सहयोग स भारतीय नेता सुरज्ञनारायण सिंह आ अन्य सब हनुमाननगर जेल तोड़ि ओतय स भागय में मदद करय में सफल भेलाह। नेता मंडल के कहनाय छनि जे स्थानीय लोक सेहो जेल भंग के समर्थन केलक.

राणा के विरुद्ध आन्दोलन में समर्थन

पूर्व राजदूत पुरी नेपाल मे राणा शासन हटाबय मे सेहो हनुमाननगर घटना सँ सहायक भेल उल्लेख केने छथि । हनुमाननगर आन्दोलनसँ प्रज्वलित आगि सेहो राणाकेँ घेरि लेलक । नेता मंडल कहलनि जे, ओहि समय नेपाल मे बहुतो नेता के भारतीय नेता के जेल सं भागय मे मदद करय के आरोप मे गिरफ्तार कायल गेल छल. सप्तरी के किछु ठाम स लोक के गिरफ्तार क काठमांडू जेल आनल गेल।

नेपाल मे जेपी नारायण, राममनोहर लोहिया, आ अन्य लोकनि केँ आश्रय देबाक लेल तत्कालीन सरकार द्वारा रामेश्वर सिंह मुख्य आरोपी मानल गेल छल । बाद मे भारत सरकार के आग्रह पर हुनका सब के रिहा क देल गेल।

गोरखाली दुर्गा मल्ल जे अंग्रेज सेना मे छलाह तखन भारत मे अंग्रेजक विरुद्ध लड़ाई शुरू भेला पर भारतीय नेता सुभाषचन्द्र बोस केँ विद्रोह कय समर्थन केलनि । ओ पहिल गोरखाली सैनिक छलाह जे भारतक स्वतंत्रताक लेल लड़ैत अपन प्राणक बलिदान देलनि । हुनका अंग्रेज सरकार फाँसीक सजा सुना देलक। भारत केरऽ संसद भवन परिसर म॑ हुनकऽ स्मृति म॑ मूर्ति लगाय देलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

स्वतंत्रता दिवस के अवसर पर नेपाल में ही नै भारत में भी नेपाली के योगदान याद करलऽ जाय छै । 2007 बीएस मे राणा के खिलाफ आंदोलन मे भारत के पूरा समर्थन छल.

नेता मंडल कहैत छथि, ‘अंग्रेजक विरुद्ध आन्दोलनक समर्थन करबाक कारणेँ तत्कालीन भारत सरकार राणाक विरुद्ध आन्दोलन मे नेपालक नेता सभक समर्थन केलक । एहि मे सबस बेसी सहयोग जयप्रकाश नारायण आ राममनोहर लोहिया स भेटल। दुनू गोटे सुबरनशमशेर राणा केँ ल' क' भारतक तत्कालीन प्रधानमंत्री जवाहरलाल नेहरू सँ भेंट केलनि।'

मुदा प्रधानमंत्री नेहरू जवाब देलनि जे हम सशस्त्र संघर्ष के समर्थन नहि करब। ‘अहाँ सब के शांतिपूर्ण आन्दोलन होबय वाला अछि त समर्थन भेटत, अन्यथा सशस्त्र आन्दोलन के कोनो समर्थन नै होयत’ जवाब भेटलाक बाद तत्कालीन गृहमंत्री सरदार वल्लभभाई पटेल सं भेंट केलनि। गृहमंत्री पटेल जखन पुछलखिन जे हुनका सं की मदद चाही त जयप्रकाश नारायण आ लोहिया कहलनि जे गृह मंत्रालय के अधीन मशीनरी के कहब जे नेपाल के संदर्भ मे किछु दिन चुप रहू, आ बाकी काज ओ सब स्वयं करब।

तकर बाद जयप्रकाश नारायण आदि लोकनि बर्मा सँ हथियार आनि बी.पी.कोइराला आदि लोकनि केँ द’ देलनि | तखन नेता मंडल स्मरण करैत छथि जे राणाक विरुद्ध सशस्त्र आन्दोलन नेपाल मे शुरू भेल छल । आपसी सहयोग के साथ लगभग एक ही समय में दुनु देश में क्रान्ति के सफलता के कारण नेपाल-भारत के संबंध के विशेष रूप स देखल जाइत अछि | नेपाल मे क्रूर राणा शासन छल, ठीक ओहिना जेना भारत मे ब्रिटिश शासन छल ।

ओहि समय मे कतेको नेता जेल मे बंद छलाह। किछु गोटे भारत मे निर्वासन मे रहय लेल मजबूर भ गेलाह, जखन कि राणा लोकनि किछु नेताक संपत्ति तक जब्त क लेलनि। राजनीतिक विश्लेषक लोकनिक कहब छनि जे भारत सँ अंग्रेज केँ हटाबय मे जतेक प्रयास कयल गेल छल तहिना नेपाल मे राणा शासन केँ हटाबय लेल सेहो ओही प्रयासक आवश्यकता छल, आ भारतक समर्थन अपार छल ।

नेपाली कांग्रेसक स्थापना जनवरी १९४७ मे भारतक खालसा कॉलेजमे भेल छल । पुरान पत्रकार सुकेश्वर पाठक के कहनाय छनि जे ओहि समय के घोषणापत्र मे नेता सभ भारत आओर नेपाल के स्वतंत्रता के लेल बराबर लड़ाई लड़य के वचन देलखिन्ह.

नेपालक राणा लोकनि भारत मे अंग्रेजक विरुद्ध आन्दोलन केँ दबाबय मे अंग्रेज केँ सहयोग कयलनि ताहि सँ सेहो ई विश्वास उत्पन्न भेल जे एहि शासन केँ समाप्त करय पड़त, आ भारत सँ समर्थन भेटल। ओहि समय नेपाल मे नीक स्कूल आ कॉलेजक अभाव मे अधिकांश नेपाली छात्र भारतक विभिन्न कॉलेज मे जाइत छलाह |

ओतय आयोजित हर आंदोलन, रैली, आ सम्मेलन मे भाग लैत छलाह | हुनका लोकनिक उदाहरणक अनुसरण करैत ओ विद्यार्थी लोकनि (जे बाद मे नेता बनलाह) नेपाल मे आन्दोलन शुरू केलनि ।

full_article:
As you enter, cutting across the entire breadth of the room is a red brick and terracotta-tone wall fitted with lattice screens, centuries-old ‘ Tiki Jhya ’ or ‘ Ankhi Jhya’ -inspired windows and sculpted columns with intricate wood carvings that are typical to Newari architecture in the Kathmandu Valley. To complement the earthy, wooden interiors is the deep teal-coloured seating with woven cane backrests. Well-lit and lively, with Nepali songs playing to match the mood, further inside you find more terracotta doors, private rooms and white walls adorned with traditional thangka-style artworks and Tibetan tapestries, just as one would find in homes in Manang and Mustang.

The food and drinks

Mutton Momo Jimbu Thakali Trout Jhol Jimbu Thakali

Address: Lower Ground Floor, R3-27–31, M3M 65th Avenue, Sector 65, Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram

Price for Two: Rs1,500 plus taxes

Instagram; Website

“Back in the day in Thak-Khola, not a single grain of rice was cultivated, unlike in the other side of the country. This made it a rare commodity here. So when Thakalis cooked rice, they made sure everything around it was premium,” explains Sherchan. True to this sentiment, in our Thakali Mutton Thali set, surrounding the dome of fragrant rice was kalo daal tempered with jimbu, mutton curry, jimbu aloo, sadheko gundruk (fermented rayo ko saag leaves), fried bitter gourd, saag, mula (radish) pickle, tomato chutney, salad, dahi and papad. The same Thakali Thali set is available in options of chicken, fish or vegetarian, with a choice between paneer or pharsi for the latter. Other available substitutions include the Dhido Thali set, in which the rice is replaced with dhido (mashed buckwheat) or the Ghoken Thali set, in which two buckwheat rotis replace the dhido. Whichever set you do choose starts with a very ceremonious pour of piping hot khareko gheu (ghee) from a steel kettle.

As we ate, I smiled, because my aunt’s words did ring true. We’ve grown up eating kalo daal bhaat at home, as all Nepalis do. Gundruk, saag, sadheko aloo as well. But the Thakali cooking method for the same item is unique, its flavour too because of the use of jimbu and generous pours of khareko gheu. That authentic Thakali taste is hard to find in India’s Northeast, even more so in Delhi NCR.

शेरचन बतबैत छथि, "पहिने दिन मे ठाक-खोला मे देशक दोसर कातक विपरीत एको दाना चाउरक खेती नहि होइत छल। एहि सँ एतय ई एकटा दुर्लभ वस्तु बनि गेल छल। तेँ जखन ठकली चाउर पकाबैत छल तखन ओ सब ई सुनिश्चित करैत छल जे ओकर आसपासक सब किछु प्रीमियम हो। एहि भावना के सच्चाई स हमर सबहक ठकली मटन थाली सेट में सुगंधित चाउर के गुंबद के चारू कात जिम्बू, मटन करी, जिम्बू आलू, साधेको गुंडरुक (किण्वित रायो को साग के पात), तनल तीत लौकी, साग, मुला (मूला) अचार, टमाटर के चटनी, सलाद, दाही आ पापड़ स टेम्पर्ड कलो दाल छल. वही ठकली थाली सेट चिकन, माछ या शाकाहारी के विकल्प में उपलब्ध छै, बाद वाला के लेल पनीर या फार्सी के बीच विकल्प छै. अन्य उपलब्ध प्रतिस्थापन में धीडो थाली सेट शामिल अछि, जाहि में चावल के जगह धिडो (मसले एक प्रकार के अनाज) या घोकेन थाली सेट, जाहि में दू टा एक प्रकार के रोटी धिडो के जगह लैत अछि | जे सेट चुनब से शुरू होइत अछि स्टील के केतली स पाइपिंग गरम खरको घेउ (घी) के बहुत विधिवत ढार स ।

China, Nepal mark 71 years of diplomatic relations at Kathmandu reception

(Xinhua) 13:48, August 15, 2026

Chinese Ambassador to Nepal Zhang Maoming (7th R, back), Nepal's Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai (8th L, back), and winners of the China-Nepal friendship short video contest pose for a group photo in Kathmandu, Nepal, Aug. 13, 2026. A reception to mark the 71st anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and Nepal, combined with the award ceremony for a China-Nepal friendship short video contest, was held in Kathmandu on Thursday. (Photo by Hari Maharjan/Xinhua)

A reception to mark the 71st anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and Nepal, combined with the award ceremony for a China-Nepal friendship short video contest, was held in Kathmandu on Thursday.

In his address, Nepal's Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai reviewed the bilateral engagement since the two countries formally established ties in 1955, noting that Nepal and China have consistently advanced their relationship on the basis of the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence.

Rai reaffirmed Nepal's firm adherence to the one-China principle, stressing that the country will never allow its territory to be used in any way to harm China's core national interests.

Chinese Ambassador to Nepal Zhang Maoming underscored the long-standing friendship between the two neighbours, which has remained resilient despite changes in the international environment. He noted that since the formation of Nepal's new government in March this year, political mutual trust between Nepal and China has continued to deepen, and high-quality Belt and Road cooperation has continued to advance with solid results.

Zhang also highlighted growing people-to-people exchanges, noting that simple yet heartfelt exchanges between the two peoples have altogether become the true foundation and defining character of Nepal-China friendship nowadays.

Rai and Zhang jointly presented trophies and certificates to the winners of the short video contest, which had drawn numerous submissions, garnering a combined 880,000 online views.

(Web editor: Huang Kechao, Wang Yuqing)

full_article:
Kathmandu. The Nepal Oil Corporation has faced widespread criticism for making citizenship or identity cards mandatory for citizens coming to collect cooking LPG gas, in an effort to streamline gas distribution. Citizens are expressing dissatisfaction with this arrangement through social media and various other platforms.

The corporation had issued a notice on Friday, informing about the arrangement for selling and distributing gas from five locations in the Kathmandu Valley on Saturday. The notice stated that a citizenship certificate and national identity card must be brought when coming to collect gas.

Widespread criticism has arisen after the corporation made citizenship and national identity cards mandatory for collecting gas. According to Nepal Oil Corporation spokesperson Manoj Thakur, this arrangement has been made to ensure that gas distribution is orderly, transparent, and reaches genuine consumers. He stated that it has been observed that some individuals were taking multiple cylinders of gas and stocking them up.

As a result, consumers who genuinely need gas immediately have been deprived. The corporation's clarification is that this measure has been implemented to solve this problem and to keep a record of genuinely needy consumers to provide them with gas easily, by making identification documents mandatory.

Spokesperson Thakur also stated that even without a citizenship or national identity card, gas can be collected if the individual has other identification documents that confirm their identity (such as a voter ID card, student ID card, or other official documents). He claimed that by distributing gas upon presentation of identification documents, a clear record will be maintained of who received how much, and black marketing and unnecessary hoarding will be prevented.

Spokesperson Thakur said that this arrangement is not intended to trouble any citizen but is a step taken to ensure gas for genuinely needy consumers who require it immediately. The corporation has informed that it will not deprive any citizen through this arrangement and has urged its depots and vendors to prioritize providing gas to consumers facing genuine problems.

निगम द्वारा गैस वसूली के लेल नागरिकता आ राष्ट्रीय पहचान पत्र अनिवार्य करला के बाद व्यापक आलोचना उठल अछि। नेपाल तेल निगम के प्रवक्ता मनोज ठाकुर के अनुसार गैस वितरण व्यवस्थित, पारदर्शी, आ वास्तविक उपभोक्ता तक पहुँचै के लेल ई व्यवस्था करलऽ गेलऽ छै । ओ कहलनि जे, देखल गेल अछि जे किछु व्यक्ति गैस के कईटा सिलेंडर ल क स्टॉक क रहल छल।

एकरऽ परिणाम ई छै कि जे उपभोक्ता क॑ वास्तव म॑ गैस के तुरंत जरूरत छै, वू वंचित होय गेलऽ छै । निगम केरऽ स्पष्टीकरण ई छै कि ई उपाय क॑ ई समस्या के समाधान लेली आरू वास्तविक जरूरतमंद उपभोक्ता के रिकॉर्ड रखै लेली लागू करलऽ गेलऽ छै ताकि ओकरा आसानी स॑ गैस उपलब्ध कराय सक॑, पहचान दस्तावेज क॑ अनिवार्य करी क॑ ।

प्रवक्ता ठाकुर न॑ ई भी बतैलकै कि बिना नागरिकता या राष्ट्रीय पहचान पत्र के भी गैस वसूली करलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै अगर व्यक्ति के पास ओकरऽ पहचान के पुष्टि करै वाला अन्य पहचान पत्र (जैना कि मतदाता आईडी कार्ड, छात्र आईडी कार्ड, या अन्य आधिकारिक दस्तावेज) छै । हुनकऽ दावा छै कि पहचान पत्र पेश करला प॑ गैस बाँटला स॑ केकरा कतेक मिललै एकरऽ स्पष्ट रिकॉर्ड रखलऽ जैतै, आरू ब्लैक मार्केटिंग आरू अनावश्यक जमाखोरी क॑ रोकलऽ जैतै ।

प्रवक्ता ठाकुर कहलनि जे, ई व्यवस्था कोनो नागरिक के परेशान करय के उद्देश्य सं नहि अछि बल्कि ई एकटा कदम अछि जे वास्तविक जरूरतमंद उपभोक्ता के लेल गैस सुनिश्चित करय के अछि जिनका तत्काल जरूरत अछि. निगम एहि व्यवस्था क माध्यम स कोनो नागरिक कए वंचित नहि करबाक जानकारी देलक अछि आ अपन डिपो आ विक्रेता स आग्रह केलक अछि जे ओ वास्तविक समस्या क सामना करय वाला उपभोक्ता कए गैस उपलब्ध कराबय कए प्राथमिकता देथि।

title: Body Modification Artist Kabinraj Puri Sets Global Stage for Nepali Art - Ratopati
description: Body Modification Artist Kabinraj Puri Sets Global Stage for Nepali Art  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Many of us consider the body a gift from birth. This is natural. But for 27-year-old Kabinraj Puri of Hetauda, the body is a canvas.

Known as 'Anthony Body Arts', he considers 'body modification' an artistic expression of an individual's identity, emotions, and freedom.

Kabin, Nepal's first body modification artist, has embarked on a mission to take Nepali body modification art to the world stage by setting international world records. He has a distinct identity outside Nepal, especially in the field of 'eyeball tattoo' (tattooing on the white part of the eye). 'For me, body modification is not just art, but also a medium to bring out a person's inner emotions,' he says, 'Sometimes, people can express who they truly are better through their body than through words.'

He enjoys the process of changing the body's form or structure. Tattoos, piercings (wearing jewelry by piercing ears, nose, lips, tongue, navel, etc.), tongue splitting (splitting the tongue into two parts from the middle), implants (changing shape by placing materials under the skin) are among his hobbies.

The starting point of his body modification journey is tattoos. As a child, he was influenced by a foreigner named 'Anthony Sign'. This was about fifteen years ago. Anthony had a tattoo on his face with his mother's permission. Seeing that, Kabin felt – 'I will also get a tattoo like this.' Today, his 'Anthony Body Arts' is associated with that foreigner.

His father was working in the Nepali army, so the home environment was strict. His parents dreamed that their son would get a government job. But his desire and dream were in tattoos. At the age of 12, he tattooed a 'star' on his own body. After that, he became addicted to tattoos.

Initially, he started making tattoos by setting up a studio at home. It was not a time when society easily accepted this profession. He would tattoo his friends after taking money from them. He tried to explain at home that this was 'art', but no one listened to him. Finally, he moved to Kathmandu. 8-10 years ago, tattoos were just starting to become popular in Kathmandu. After his contact with foreigners increased, he was able to sustain himself in Kathmandu. Then, gradually, he learned more about body modification.

Many people desire body modification but also fear it. Many worry about the risks to the skin and body parts. But he claims there is no risk in it and safety is his top priority.

According to him, all the equipment used is placed in a high-level 'steam sterilization machine' (sterilization device). This destroys bacteria, viruses, and other harmful microorganisms. Puri said that no procedure starts without ensuring all equipment is completely safe. 'I explain the entire sterilization process to the clients. They need to feel confident that their health is safe,' he said, 'Trust and cleanliness are the biggest foundations of my work.'

The day I split my own tongue in front of the mirror...

Kabin's most difficult experience was not on anyone else, but on his own body. He performed his own 'tongue split' (the process of splitting the tongue or dividing it into two parts).

He recalls that splitting his own tongue in front of the mirror was an extremely challenging experience physically and mentally. 'That was the most difficult decision of my life. I tested myself. It wasn't just a physical change, but also a test of my willpower, patience, and commitment,' he shared.

Before starting any procedure, he makes his workplace calm and positive. Once the procedure begins, his entire focus is on the client and his own work. He doesn't talk to anyone. 'While working, I don't talk unnecessarily; my entire focus is on the client's safety,' he said.

Journey to World Records

In 2023, Kabin achieved an international world record through eyeball tattoos. He gained international recognition for the eyeball tattoos done on Tahir Hussain of India and Pavi Fernando of Sri Lanka. He also received the 'Guinness World Record', which has made him more recognized in the international body modification community.

While achieving world records is a matter of pride, he considers the love given by other artists and clients his real capital. 'World records broadened my identity. But the respect given to me by artists and clients comes from my continuous hard work, quality, and honesty,' he sounded happy.

Initially, when people didn't understand body modification, few were interested in him. Some even discouraged him. But he learned on his own, forged his own path, and reached the international stage.

Body modification is not yet very popular in Nepal. Therefore, most of his clients come from abroad. He has the experience of working with foreign clients because they are more knowledgeable about body modification. 'Their first interest is in safety and hygiene. I pay the most attention to those aspects. Many foreign clients are happy to see such quality work being done in Nepal,' he shared.

According to Kabin, every client has a different story. Some come to express their identity, some to remember a special life experience, and some to feel like a new person. Kabin considers the client's happiness his 'reward'.

He says that in Nepal, there is still a tendency to associate body modification with drugs or a negative lifestyle. 'I myself do not use drugs. I want to introduce body modification as a responsible, safe, and professional art,' he added, 'The image of the entire art has been tarnished because some people associate it with drug culture.' He believes it is necessary to associate this art with responsibility, discipline, and respect.

'Living life on my own terms is success'

Society is focused on material comforts, but for Kabin, success is not limited to material comforts alone. A simple life without luxury is his dream. 'I am not tempted by luxury. My success is being able to live the life I want, do the work I love, and live with dignity,' he said.

His goal is to take his art to various countries around the world. He dreams of going to countries like Europe and America, exchanging experiences with other artists, learning new techniques, and making 'Anthony Body Arts' known globally from Nepal.

In the future, he plans to establish his own body modification academy to train the new generation. However, he emphasizes teaching ethics, safety, and responsibility before skills.

Despite world records, international recognition, and growing popularity, Kabin still considers himself an artist who is still learning. For him, body modification is not just an exercise in changing the body; it is a medium of art, discipline, responsibility, and self-identity. He continues to be a dedicated practitioner in this field.

काठमांडू। हमरा लोकनि मे सँ बहुतो गोटे जन्महि सँ शरीर केँ वरदान मानैत छी। ई स्वाभाविक अछि। मुदा हेटौड़ा के 27 वर्षीय कबीनराज पुरी के लेल शरीर कैनवास अछि।

‘एंथोनी बॉडी आर्ट्स’ के नाम स॑ जानलऽ जाय वाला हुनी ‘बॉडी मोडिफिकेशन’ क॑ व्यक्ति केरऽ पहचान, भावना, आरू स्वतंत्रता के कलात्मक अभिव्यक्ति मान॑ छै ।

नेपालक पहिल बॉडी मोडिफिकेशन कलाकार कबिन नेपाली बॉडी मोडिफिकेशन आर्ट केँ विश्व पटल पर पहुँचेबाक मिशन पर उतरल छथि, अंतरराष्ट्रीय विश्व रिकॉर्ड बनौलनि अछि। नेपाल सँ बाहर विशेष रूप सँ ‘आइगोल टैटू’ (आँखिक उज्जर भाग पर गोदना गोदना) के क्षेत्र मे हुनकर एकटा अलग पहचान छनि | ओ कहैत छथि, 'हमरा लेल बॉडी मोडिफिकेशन मात्र कला नहि, बल्कि व्यक्तिक भीतरक भावना केँ सोझाँ अनबाक माध्यम सेहो अछि, 'कखनो काल लोक शब्द सँ बेसी अपन शरीरक माध्यमे ई व्यक्त क' सकैत अछि जे ओ सही मायने मे के छथि।'

शरीरक रूप वा संरचना बदलबाक प्रक्रिया मे हुनका आनन्द भेटैत छनि । गोदना, छेदन (कान, नाक, ठोर, जीभ, नाभि आदि बेध कए गहना पहिरब), जीभ फाड़ब (बीच सँ जीह केँ दू भाग मे बाँटि देब), प्रत्यारोपण (चमड़ाक नीचा सामग्री राखि आकार बदलब) हुनक शौक मे सँ एक अछि ।

हुनकऽ बॉडी मोडिफिकेशन यात्रा केरऽ शुरुआती बिंदु गोदना छै । नेनपन मे हुनका पर 'एंथोनी साइन' नामक एकटा विदेशी के प्रभाव पड़ल छलनि । ई बात करीब पन्द्रह साल पहिने के अछि। एन्थोनी के चेहरा पर माय के अनुमति स गोदना गोदना गोदने छल। से देखि कबिन के लागलै – ‘हमरोॅ भी एना गोदना गोदना गोदना।’ आइ हुनक 'एन्थोनी बॉडी आर्ट्स' ओहि विदेशी सँ जुड़ल अछि ।

पिता नेपाली सेना मे काज करैत छलाह, तेँ घरक वातावरण कठोर छल । हुनकर माता-पिता सपना देखैत छलाह जे हुनकर बेटा के सरकारी नौकरी भेटतनि। मुदा ओकर इच्छा आ सपना गोदना मे छलैक। १२ वर्षक उमेरमे ओ अपनहि शरीरमे ‘स्टार’ गोदना गोदौलनि । तकर बाद गोदना गोदवाक लत लागि गेलनि।

शुरू मे घर मे स्टूडियो बना कए गोदना गोदबय लगलाह। ओ समय नहि छल जखन समाज एहि पेशा केँ सहजता सँ स्वीकार क' लेत। अपन संगी सभसँ पाइ लऽ कऽ गोदना गोदबैत छलाह । घर मे बुझेबाक प्रयास केलनि जे ई ‘कला’ थिक, मुदा कियो हुनकर बात नहि सुनलक। अंततः काठमांडू आबि गेलाह। 8-10 साल पहिने काठमांडू मे गोदना गोदना लोकप्रिय होबय लागल छल. विदेशी सँ सम्पर्क बढ़लाक बाद काठमांडू मे अपन पेट भरय मे सफल भेलाह । तखन धीरे-धीरे हुनका बॉडी मोडिफिकेशन के बारे मे बेसी जानकारी भेटलनि।

बहुत लोक बॉडी मोडिफिकेशन के इच्छा रखैत छथि मुदा डर सेहो रखैत छथि । बहुत लोग त्वचा आ शरीर कें अंगक कें लेल खतरा कें चिंता करएयत छै. लेकिन हुनकऽ दावा छै कि एकरा म॑ कोय जोखिम नै छै आरू सुरक्षा हुनकऽ सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता छै ।

हुनकऽ अनुसार उपयोग करलऽ जाय वाला सब उपकरण क॑ उच्च स्तरीय ‘स्टीम स्टीरिलाइजेशन मशीन’ (स्टेरिलाइजेशन डिवाइस) म॑ रखलऽ जाय छै । अइ सं बैक्टीरिया, वायरस आ अन्य हानिकारक सूक्ष्मजीवक कें नष्ट भ जायत छै. पुरी कहला जे बिना सबटा उपकरण कए पूर्ण रूप स सुरक्षित रखल कोनो प्रक्रिया शुरू नहि होइत अछि। 'हम ग्राहक के पूरा नसबंदी प्रक्रिया बुझबैत छी।' हुनका सब क॑ ई बात के भरोसा महसूस करै के जरूरत छै कि हुनकऽ स्वास्थ्य सुरक्षित छै,’ हुनी कहलकै, ‘विश्वास आरू साफ-सफाई हमरऽ काम केरऽ सबस॑ बड़ऽ आधार छै ।’

जाहि दिन हम ऐना के सामने अपन जीह फाड़ि देलहुं...

कबिनक सबसँ कठिन अनुभव ककरो आन पर नहि, अपनहि देह पर छल । ओ अपन ‘जीह विभाजन’ (जीह केँ फाड़बाक प्रक्रिया वा दू भाग मे बाँटि देबाक प्रक्रिया) केने छलाह |

हुनका स्मरण छै कि ऐना के सामने अपनऽ जीभ फाड़ना शारीरिक आरू मानसिक रूप स॑ अत्यंत चुनौतीपूर्ण अनुभव छेलै । 'ओ हमर जीवनक सबसँ कठिन निर्णय छल ।' हम अपनाकेँ परखलहुँ। ई खाली शारीरिक परिवर्तन नै छेलै, बल्कि हमरऽ इच्छाशक्ति, धैर्य आरू प्रतिबद्धता के परीक्षा भी छेलै,' हुनी साझा करलकै ।

कोनो प्रक्रिया शुरू करय सं पहिने ओ अपन कार्यस्थल के शांत आ सकारात्मक बना दैत छथिन्ह. एक बेर प्रक्रिया शुरू भ गेलाक बाद ओकर पूरा ध्यान ग्राहक आ ओकर अपन काज पर रहैत छैक । ककरोसँ गप्प नहि करैए। 'काज करैत काल हम अनावश्यक गप्प नहि करैत छी; हमर पूरा ध्यान ग्राहकक सुरक्षा पर अछि।'

विश्व रिकॉर्ड के यात्रा

2023 मे कबिन आईबॉल टैटू के माध्यम सं अंतरराष्ट्रीय विश्व रिकॉर्ड बनौलखिन्ह. भारत केरऽ ताहिर हुसैन आरू श्रीलंका केरऽ पावी फर्नांडो प॑ करलऽ गेलऽ आंखऽ के गोला के टैटू लेली हुनका अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर प॑ पहचान मिललै । हुनका ‘गिनीज वर्ल्ड रिकॉर्ड’ भी मिललै, जेकरा स॑ हुनका अंतरराष्ट्रीय बॉडी मोडिफिकेशन समुदाय म॑ अधिक पहचान मिललऽ छै ।

विश्व रिकॉर्ड हासिल करब गर्व के बात छै, लेकिन अन्य कलाकार आरू ग्राहक द्वारा देलऽ गेलऽ प्रेम क॑ हुनी अपनऽ असली पूंजी मान॑ छै । 'विश्व रिकॉर्ड हमर पहचान केँ व्यापक बना देलक।' मुदा कलाकार आ ग्राहक द्वारा हमरा जे सम्मान भेटैत अछि से हमर निरंतर मेहनत, गुणवत्ता, आ ईमानदारी स भेटैत अछि,' ओ खुश सन लगैत छलाह।

शुरू मे जखन लोक बॉडी मोडिफिकेशन के नहि बुझैत छल त हुनका मे रुचि कम लोक के छल. किछु गोटे त हुनका हतोत्साहित तक क देलखिन। मुदा ओ अपनहि सीखलनि, अपन बाट गढ़लनि, आ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मंच पर पहुँचि गेलाह।

नेपाल मे एखन धरि बॉडी मोडिफिकेशन बहुत लोकप्रिय नहि अछि । तेँ हुनकर अधिकांश मुवक्किल विदेशसँ अबैत छथि । हुनका विदेशी ग्राहक के साथ काम करै के अनुभव छै, कैन्हेंकि हुनका बॉडी मोडिफिकेशन के बारे में बेसी जानकारी छै । 'हिनका लोकनिक पहिल रुचि सुरक्षा आ स्वच्छता मे छनि।' हम ओहि पक्ष पर सबसँ बेसी ध्यान दैत छी। नेपाल मे एहन गुणवत्तापूर्ण काज होइत देखि बहुतो विदेशी ग्राहक खुश छथि।'

कबिन क अनुसार हर क्लाइंट क कहानी अलग-अलग होइत अछि। कियो अपन पहिचान व्यक्त करय लेल अबैत छथि, कियो जीवनक कोनो विशेष अनुभव मोन पाड़य लेल, त कियो नव व्यक्ति जकाँ महसूस करय लेल। कबिन ग्राहकक खुशी केँ अपन 'इनाम' मानैत छथि ।

हुनकऽ कहना छै कि नेपाल म॑ अखनी भी शरीर केरऽ संशोधन क॑ नशा या नकारात्मक जीवनशैली स॑ जोड़ै के प्रवृत्ति छै । 'हम स्वयं नशाक प्रयोग नहि करैत छी ।' हम शरीर संशोधन के एकटा जिम्मेदार, सुरक्षित, आ पेशेवर कला के रूप में शुरू करय चाहैत छी,' ओ आगू कहलनि, 'पूरी कला के छवि पर कलंक लागल अछि, कारण किछु लोक एकरा ड्रग कल्चर सं जोड़ैत छथि.' हुनकऽ मानना ​​छै कि ई कला क॑ जिम्मेदारी, अनुशासन, आरू सम्मान स॑ जोड़ना जरूरी छै ।

'अपन शर्त पर जीवन जीब सफलता थिक'।

समाज भौतिक सुख-सुविधा पर केंद्रित अछि, मुदा कबिन लेल सफलता केवल भौतिक सुख-सुविधा तक सीमित नहि अछि। विलासिता के बिना साधारण जीवन ओकर सपना छै। 'हमरा विलासिताक प्रलोभन नहि भेटैत अछि।' हमर सफलता अछि जे हम जे जीवन चाहैत छी से जीबि सकब, जे काज हमरा नीक लगैत अछि से क' सकब, आ मर्यादाक संग जीब' मे सक्षम छी।'

हुनकऽ लक्ष्य छै कि हुनकऽ कला क॑ दुनिया केरऽ विभिन्न देशऽ म॑ पहुँचै के छै । हुनकऽ सपना छै कि यूरोप आरू अमेरिका जैसनऽ देशऽ म॑ जाय क॑ दोसरऽ कलाकारऽ स॑ अनुभव के आदान-प्रदान करी क॑ नया-नया तकनीक सीखलऽ जाय, आरू नेपाल स॑ ‘एंथोनी बॉडी आर्ट्स’ क॑ वैश्विक स्तर प॑ जानलऽ जाय ।

भविष्य मे नव पीढ़ी कए प्रशिक्षित करबा लेल हुनकर अपन बॉडी मोडिफिकेशन अकादमी स्थापित करबाक योजना अछि। मुदा, कौशल सं पहिने नैतिकता, सुरक्षा, आ जिम्मेदारी सिखाबय पर जोर दैत छथि.

विश्व रिकॉर्ड, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय पहचान, आरू बढ़तऽ लोकप्रियता के बावजूद कबिन अखनी भी खुद क॑ एगो ऐसनऽ कलाकार मान॑ छै जे अखनी भी सीखी रहलऽ छै । हुनका लेल शरीर संशोधन मात्र शरीर बदलबाक व्यायाम नहिं थिक; ई कला, अनुशासन, जिम्मेदारी, आ आत्म-पहचान के माध्यम छै. एहि क्षेत्र मे ओ समर्पित व्यवसायी बनल रहैत छथि ।
